description: 8-AI remote Ethernet I/O, Modbus/TCP. FC04: AI_rawValue ch0-7 (addr 0-7), AI_scaledValue u32 hi/lo (8-23), AI_rawValueMin (24-31), AI_rawValueMax (32-39), AI_status (60-67; 0=normal,1=burnout,2=over range,3=under range), AI_scaledValueMin (109-124), AI_scaledValueMax (125-140). FC01: AI_resetMinValue (4145-4152), AI_resetMaxValue (4153-4160). FC03: AI_mode ch0-7 (addr 24-31; 0=0-10V,1=4-20mA,2=0-20mA,4=4-20mA burnout), AI_burnoutValue u32 hi/lo ch0-7 (addr 40-55).
